rationale: The workflow already implements the dependency-download caching optimization supported by the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE and P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE evidence: the test job uses actions/setup-python@v6.2.0 with cache: 'pip' and cache-dependency-path (setup.py, setup.cfg, tox.ini), which caches ~/.cache/pip equivalently to a separate actions/cache step. Adding another pip cache would be redundant under the contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists." Other candidate patterns are not suitable: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is a no-op with a single matrix cell and the test job is a required release check; P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow publishes to TestPyPI (release/deployment work); P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative successful-duration history (ci_history is not_a_measured_baseline); and test selection/prioritization or skip/filter changes would reduce required coverage for a release pipeline. No supported optimization remains that preserves intended build and test coverage.
